# `ferc_search_documents`

**Selected FERC search observations**

One source search-record occurrence, retaining the complete original page and its record position.

**Coverage.** Sampled. Complete selected retained search, accession-file and original-file observations. Page occurrences and literal identifiers remain distinct; broader publisher coverage requires separate evidence. *(measured 2026-10-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `ferc_search_documents.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `observation_id` | `VARCHAR` | Reader-generated identity of this selected source observation. |
| `docket` | `VARCHAR` | Selected FERC docket value. |
| `reference` | `VARCHAR` | Maintained source reference for the selected search record. |
| `accession` | `VARCHAR` | Source-stated FERC accession value; repeated observations remain distinct. |
| `description` | `VARCHAR` | Source-stated search-record description. |
| `source_page_json` | `VARCHAR` | Complete original source page JSON; record_index locates this occurrence. |
| `source_uri` | `VARCHAR` | Public URI identifying the selected source bytes. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the original selected source bytes. |
| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | Recorded acquisition observation time; null when unrecorded. Separate from publication time. |
| `record_index` | `BIGINT` | Zero-based record position in the original source page. |
